confidence_notes: July 2026 guidance and current city-level cost data support the meal, coffee, and beer estimates, though prices vary between the Old Town and quieter areas. Wine uses typical local restaurant ranges; cocktail is estimated at about 2.4 times the local draft-beer price. Accommodation is a holistic year-typical estimate and is especially season-sensitive.
comparable_city_reasoning: Kotor is a small, strongly seasonal Adriatic destination. I place its year-typical hostel and hotel costs above Krakow but generally below Madrid, with three-star lodging near Valletta's level; July demand can push prices higher.
